seo.title: J.K. Place Capri: Marina Grande Honeymoon Review (2026)
seo.description: 22-room cliff-top design hotel above Marina Grande. Score 92/100, from $1,500/night. Verdict, suite pick, 7-night itinerary.

content.verdict: J.K. Place Capri is the most polished and design-forward of the island’s great hotels — a 22-room boutique opened by the Florentine Kalpakian family in 2007, occupying a former schoolhouse on the cliff directly above Marina Grande, with an unobstructed panoramic view of the harbour, the Bay of Naples, and Vesuvius across the water. The interiors by Florentine designer Michele Bönan are coherent island-house chic — striped white-and-blue cottons, antique Sicilian terracotta floors, custom whitewashed-oak furniture, classical busts, and a deeply considered aesthetic that has been widely copied (and never matched) since the property opened. Twenty-two rooms means scale that is, by Capri standards, intimate but not micro. The infinity pool on the cliff-edge terrace facing the Bay of Naples is among the most photographed in Italy; the JKitchen restaurant on the panoramic terrace under chef Eduardo Estatico delivers Mediterranean cooking at a near-Michelin level (the property has won Tripadvisor’s Travelers’ Choice every year since 2018); and the in-house spa, the JKSpa, is small but excellent for couples treatments. The hotel runs its own teak gozzo boat which guests can charter for the day at preferential rates — the Marina Grande launch jetty is two minutes’ walk down the cliff steps below the hotel. The honeymoon move is the Penthouse Suite — the top-floor 90 sqm suite with a vast private rooftop terrace including a hot tub, plunge pool, and 270° view of the bay. For the sweet spot, a Sea View Junior Suite with a private terrace. The defining moment: aperitivo at sunset on the cliff-edge terrace as the lights come on in Naples 30 km across the water and Vesuvius glows pink behind. Caveats: J.K. Place is in Marina Grande rather than Capri Town — the funicular up to the Piazzetta is a 2-minute walk and €2, but if you want the Piazzetta as your front door choose Quisisana or Punta Tragara; the cliff-edge means stairs (a lot of stairs) within the property; and the price is at the very top of the Capri market in summer. But for honeymooners who want the most contemporary, design-conscious, and view-led hotel on the island, J.K. Place is the unambiguous first choice.
content.best_room: The Penthouse Suite — 90 sqm with a vast private rooftop terrace, hot tub, plunge pool, and 270° view. For the sweet spot, a Sea View Junior Suite with private terrace. Avoid the standard rooms without sea views — they’re still beautiful but the harbour view is the entire reason to be at this address.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Marina Grande arrival
itinerary_7_nights.description: Private speedboat from Naples harbour to Marina Grande (70 min). Two minutes up the cliff steps to J.K. Place. Welcome champagne, then sunset aperitivo on the pool terrace. Dinner at JKitchen.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Around the island by boat
itinerary_7_nights.description: Private gozzo boat for the day from the hotel’s arrangement — Faraglioni arch swim, Blue Grotto, lunch at Lido del Faro on the Anacapri cliffs. Return for the pool and JKitchen dinner.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Da Paolino lunch
itinerary_7_nights.description: Late morning walk to Da Paolino (15 min downhill) — lemon-tree lunch. Funicular up to the Piazzetta. Afternoon shopping on via Camerelle. Aperitivo at Quisisana. Dinner at J.K. Place.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Villa Jovis and Capri Town
itinerary_7_nights.description: Early funicular up to the Piazzetta. Walk to Villa Jovis (45 min uphill, 8am start). Lunch at La Capannina in Capri Town. Afternoon at the pool. Dinner at Aurora.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Anacapri day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Taxi to Anacapri. Chairlift to Monte Solaro summit. Lunch at Da Gelsomina. Afternoon at Villa San Michele. Dinner at Il Riccio (1 Michelin star) at Capri Palace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Da Luigi at the Faraglioni
itinerary_7_nights.description: Da Luigi shuttle boat from Marina Piccola. Sunbeds at Da Luigi ai Faraglioni. Lunch at Da Luigi. Afternoon swim and nap. Aperitivo at the J.K. Place pool. Final dinner at JKitchen.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast on the terrace. Walk down to Marina Grande for the private speedboat back to Naples.

caveats: Marina Grande location, not Capri Town. Funicular up to Piazzetta is 2 min walk + 4 min ride.
Cliff-edge property means many internal stairs. Not for guests with mobility limitations.
Summer rates at the absolute top of the Capri market — book May, June, September for value.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Among the top three Capri honeymoons — design, view, intimacy, and JKitchen combine into the most polished experience on the island.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, September, October. Closed November to mid-April. The Penthouse Suite is most spectacular in late September.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Penthouse Suite 9–12 months for May–September. Sea View Junior Suites 6 months. Hotel sells out 6+ months ahead in summer.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No, but the 22-room intimate scale and rate mean families are rare. Atmosphere is intensely adult.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Penthouse Suite for the pinnacle. Sea View Junior Suite for the sweet spot. Avoid no-view standard rooms.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Naples Capodichino (NAP) is the airport. Private speedboat from Naples harbour direct to Marina Grande (70 min, €500–€800), or Sorrento hydrofoil to Marina Grande (25 min, €25pp).
